title: Justified project overrides
description: Your project's own decisions to depart from rules and guidelines of Justified by Blackwood & Blake. Each needs a reason.

justified.description: The Justified version the file was written for. Informational.

id.description: One exact id, such as FRM-004. No wildcards or families. An id that Justified does not have is not a schema error: the linter warns and ignores it, or throws with strict.

action.description: off: the project does not follow the text. guideline: treat a rule as a guideline that yields to the project's own convention (not for a WCAG requirement). note: the text applies in full; the reason is context.

reason.description: Your project's own words for the decision.

files.description: Positive globs, relative to this file. Without it, the whole project.

rule_version.description: The version of the rule the override was written against.

review_by.description: A date to look at the decision again. ESLint ignores it.

lint_rules.description: Limits off and guideline to some of the id's lint rules.
